title: SPBR Thermal Extention
description: Add some cool PBR effect to Thermal Series
body:
I always like using SPBR and playing modpacks with Thermal Series.Have you ever thought that what if Thermal machines can alse display a fancy reflecting looking? I spent 2 whole days to make that come true!

我一直很喜欢SPBR材质包，也很喜欢玩带有热力系列的整合包。你们想象过如果模组机器也能拥有那种很炫的反射效果？我花了两天把这个想法付诸实现，十分感谢SPBR的作者Shulker提供的部分贴图，让我这个SPBR风格的资源包能够实现。目前是一个早期的版本
